text:
ops-bot: [ALERT] Route error spike — 5xx rate > threshold for service 'inference-gateway' (detected at 2026-03-14T02:13:54Z)

maria: saw this. customers hitting intermittent 503s, PD pages going off fast. I'm oncall, looking at logs now. @sam can you take routing side?

sam: on it. checking recent deploys and infra. nothing obvious in deploy history. can you paste the errors per route? :thinking_face: 

maria: here — short dump from logs:
```
2026-03-14T02:12:11Z inference-gateway route=/v1/generate status=503 resp_time=120ms err="upstream: reconnect"
2026-03-14T02:12:34Z inference-gateway route=/v1/chat status=502 resp_time=90ms err="connection reset"
2026-03-14T02:12:43Z inference-gateway route=/v1/embeddings status=503 resp_time=30ms err="backend timeout"
```

jordan: looks like multiple routes. The PD groups are per-service; that causes N pages. can we adjust PD grouping or dedupe temporarily? paging is drowning on-call.

maria: yes. proposal:
- temporarily increase PD dedupe window to 10m
- update alert thresholds to require 2m sustained > threshold
- add a dashboard panel for per-route 5xx rate and per-customer error counts
- create a short-lived rate limit on alerts route to 1 alert/min after dedupe

sam: agree. let's do minimal changes during incident. i'll change the alert 'for' to 2m and add a label 'route' so PD can group by route. who can touch PD rules? @anita?

anita: can do. sending PD API patch now. curl:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://api.pagerduty.com/services/P123/rules" \
 -H "Authorization: Token token=***" \
 -H "Accept: application/vnd.pagerduty+json;version=2" \
 -d '{"rule": {"dedup_interval": 600, "group_by": ["route"]}}'
```

ops-bot: action logged — incident #INC-2026-314 created, severity: high, customer impact: intermittent 503s for a subset of traffic. tags: alert-flapping, oncall-mitigation

maria: thanks. i'm rolling a short-term routing rollback on the canary for /v1/embeddings (pinned to older backend). watching logs.

sam: updated Prometheus alert rule (pushed to alertmanager):
```
- alert: Route5xxSpike
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gateway",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (route) > 0.05
  for: 1m
```
changed to:
```
- alert: Route5xxSpike
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gateway",status=~"5.."}[10m])) by (route) > 0.07
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

sam: pushed, reloaded Prometheus, alertmanager now receives fewer flaps. visible drop in PD duplicate pages.

customer-success: getting customer reports. ETA for fix? need to update affected customers.

maria: short-term rollback reduced errors on /v1/embeddings. still seeing /v1/chat flapping. tracking those backend pools.

jordan: I'm creating a dashboard panel: "5xx rate by route (6h)" and a per-customer error heatmap. I'll share link when ready.

jordan: dashboard link: https://grafana.company.internal/d/abcd/errors-by-route?orgId=1 :eyes: 

anita: PD rule applied. also set rate_limit on notifications channel to 1/min for service P123. that should keep Slack spam down.

maria: good. can we add a temporary SLO suppression for affected customers to avoid alerts firing from downstream checks? maybe add ignore label for 'currently-mitigating'

sam: added label to alertmanager silences for affected routes for 15m. also created a runbook note in incident ticket.

ops-bot: incident #INC-2026-314 updated: mitigation actions: PD dedupe 10m, alert 'for' -> 2m, Prom rule expr window -> 10m, dashboard created, temporary rollback on embeddings.

anita: follow-up items (created issue INF-4512):
- evaluate alert thresholds per-route
- add grouping by 'route' to Prom -> PD mapping permanently
- add automatic alert-rate limiter in alertmanager
- create runbook for partial backend rollbacks
assigned to: anita

maria: handing off to @sam — my shift ends in 15m, please monitor for the next hour and update ticket. :wave:

sam: ack, i'll monitor and escalate if needed. thanks all.

jordan: final note — noise volume dropped ~85% after changes. keeping the dashboard and PD config for 24h observation, then we'll do a post-incident tuning session.

maria: thanks team. closing loop here, will post formal postmortem with timelines and customer impact later.

ops-bot: incident #INC-2026-314 status: mitigated -> monitoring

anita: opened follow-up RFC for permanent dedupe/grouping and alert rate-limiting: RFC-2026-09

sam: leaving final comment in the ticket with links to diffs and dashboard panels.

maria: closing thread from Slack, follow-up in ticket INF-4512. :lock:
